meta.description: Fictional Ellucian-style student records for the President Weekly Student Success Briefing demo. No real student data. Field groups follow ROADMAP.md sections 4 and 5. Planted demo values: M1 = -4.8 %, M2 = 42, M3 = 18, M4 = 12; row-ID lists in data/VERIFY.md.
meta.title: CampusLens - fictional spring registration fixture

counseling.counseling_notes: Chatted with the campus chaplain after chapel; settling into the semester well.
Asked about grief support after a family loss; connected with the care team and doing okay.
Feeling homesick this fall; encouraged to join a small group and check in next month.
Appreciated prayer before midterms; reports things are looking up.
New to campus and looking for community; invited to the weekly dinner group.

current.as_of_rule: as_of = max(enrollment.registration_date) over current-term rows (the 'students' list); never the wall clock
current.name: Spring 2027

in_session.as_of_rule: the term in session at the as-of date; M4's 'this term' means this term, not the spring term being registered for
in_session.name: Fall 2026

prior_year.as_of_rule: prior-year window anchored to prior_year_equivalent_date: a prior-year row counts as registered when registration_date <= prior_year_equivalent_date
prior_year.name: Spring 2026
